content.title: Social Security paid out on Wednesday, April 15, 2026: Who gets benefits today?
content.text: In the United States, certain Social Security recipients are today due to get their latest monthly benefits, in the penultimate payment on the Social Security Administration’s (SSA) schedule for April 2026.Who’s receiving Social Security today, Wednesday, April 15?The SSA is to send out Social Security benefits to recipients born on the 11th to 20th of any month. (NB: If you claim based on someone else’s work record, the agency uses the other person’s birthday.)Of the just under 71 million Americans who receive Social Security - whether retirement, disability or survivor benefits - most are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each month.In April 2026, this birthday-dependent payment cycle is:Born on 1st-10th of any month: Wednesday, April 8Born on 11th-20th of any month: Wednesday, April 15Born on 21st-31st of any month: Wednesday, April 22How much money do Social Security beneficiaries get?Retired workers: $2,079.49Disabled workers: $1,634.51Survivor benefits: $1,624.37(Average monthly benefit, according to SSA figures.)Who isn’t paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in April 2026?Certain long-term beneficiaries: April 3Social Security beneficiaries who began claiming before May 1997 are paid on the third of each month.Dual beneficiaries: April 3Social Security can be combined with Supplemental Security Income (SSI), a separate program for certain low-income individuals. Recipients of both benefits get Social Security on the third, with SSI issued on the first.How does Social Security pay monthly benefits?Direct depositSocial Security recipients can update their bank details using the SSA’s online my Social Security portal.Direct ExpressBenefits can be paid onto the Direct Express Card, a special debit card for federal disbursements made to people who do not have a bank account. Sign up at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office.Related storiesGet closer to the game!
